sources.note: Roster as it currently stands, minted at Walter's direction 2026-10-22 (no new information was found): the Village of Marshfield publishes no officer roster and has no website; the only roster is the reply of the Village Clerk/Treasurer (Meg Eberhardt) to a records inquiry, as logged in the VT Jurisdiction Factory workbook's source evidence (src-vt-reply-063-marshfield-clerk): President Arthur Gilman; Trustees Marie Olson-Badeau, Tamara McKee and Nicole Auerbach; the board totals five seats including the president, with one trustee seat vacant. Auerbach's role term is logged APPOINTED (2026-09-23), consistent with a mid-term vacancy appointment; the others are recorded elected. URL given is the Secretary of State's incorporated-villages list, which carries the village itself; the roster rests on the clerk's reply as stated.
